{"meetingId": "775", "tickets": [
{"title": "Resolve Pocket Lantern Analytics payroll portal access", "text": "Resolve the identity-verification error blocking Adrian Copperwisp from viewing direct deposit, tax withholding, and contribution setup screens on the Pocket Lantern Analytics payroll portal, which Paper Otter Benefits login does not cover.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2025-07-21", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "This payroll portal access problem remains an unresolved issue needing follow-up by 2025-07-21."},
{"title": "Obtain Pocket Lantern Analytics disability certificate", "text": "Obtain the missing Pocket Lantern Analytics long-term disability certificate for Adrian Copperwisp showing elimination period, taxable-benefit treatment, own-occupation language, and maximum monthly benefit, which were absent from the benefits packet premium schedule.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2025-07-22", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "The missing Pocket Lantern Analytics long-term disability certificate remains an unresolved issue needing follow-up by 2025-07-22."},
{"title": "Recommend interim medical coverage for gap", "text": "Provide Adrian and Lena Copperwisp a coverage recommendation for the gap between Buttonwood Balloon Robotics coverage and the first effective date under Pocket Lantern Analytics materials, accounting for Milo's continuing orthodontia and Lena's Moonbadger Health Group family plan option.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2025-07-23", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "the household needs a coverage recommendation that accounts for Milo’s orthodontia and Lena’s existing family plan option; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-07-23."},
{"title": "Compare new employer benefits against Lena's coverage", "text": "Provide Adrian Copperwisp a written comparison of Pocket Lantern Analytics medical, dental, vision, HSA, FSA, life, and disability elections against Lena's Moonbadger Health Group coverage before he submits selections through the Paper Otter Benefits portal.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2025-07-25", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "Adrian requested a written comparison of Pocket Lantern Analytics medical, dental, vision, HSA, FSA, life, and disability elections against Lena’s Moonbadger Health Group coverage before he submits the benefits portal selections. The agreed follow-up is to provide that comparison by 2025-07-25."},
{"title": "Confirm HSA eligibility under Lena's plan", "text": "Confirm for Adrian Copperwisp whether household coverage under Lena's Moonbadger Health Group plan would affect eligibility for the HSA-eligible medical option at Pocket Lantern Analytics before he chooses payroll HSA contributions.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2025-07-25", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "Adrian needs confirmation of whether household coverage under Lena’s plan would affect eligibility before he chooses payroll HSA contributions; this health savings account payroll setup issue needs follow-up by 2025-07-25."},
{"title": "Estimate FSA election amount for new employer", "text": "Estimate the household's remaining reimbursable medical expenses for Adrian Copperwisp's Pocket Lantern Analytics FSA election, accounting for Milo's continuing orthodontia and the midyear employer change.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2025-07-28", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "the household’s remaining reimbursable medical expense estimate unclear for Adrian’s new employer FSA election; the agreed follow-up on the flexible spending account election amount is due 2025-07-28."},
{"title": "Deliver final benefit election notes for Lena's review", "text": "Give Adrian Copperwisp final benefit election notes early enough for Lena Copperwisp to review them before submission, within the limited new-hire election window shown on the Paper Otter Benefits enrollment screen; write recommendations in plain language.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2025-07-29", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "he asked Apricot Compass Advisory to give him final benefit election notes early enough for Lena to review them before submission; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-07-29."},
{"title": "Update employer life insurance beneficiary designations", "text": "Complete fresh beneficiary designations required by the new Pocket Lantern Analytics benefits portal for Adrian Copperwisp, noting his former Buttonwood Balloon Robotics group life coverage ended and the 2016 estate documents still name Simon Copperwisp as successor guardian for Milo.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2025-07-30", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "The agreed follow-up on employer life insurance beneficiary designations is due 2025-07-30."},
{"title": "Verify Buttonwood 401(k) after-tax source", "text": "Verify the Buttonwood Balloon Robotics 401(k) after-tax employee contribution subaccount (about $27,500) for Adrian Copperwisp, since the year-end statement does not separately show basis, earnings, or prior in-plan Roth conversion activity.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2025-07-31", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "The agreed follow-up is to verify the Buttonwood Balloon Robotics 401(k) after-tax source by 2025-07-31."},
{"title": "Arrange old 401(k) distribution-options service call", "text": "Arrange a service call with the Buttonwood Balloon Robotics 401(k) recordkeeper for Adrian Copperwisp because the online distribution page did not display a combined pre-tax, Roth, and after-tax rollover path.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2025-08-05", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "Adrian asked for help arranging a service call with the Buttonwood Balloon Robotics 401(k) recordkeeper because the online distribution page did not display a combined pre-tax, Roth, and after-tax rollover path. {"title": "Collect Pocket Lantern equity award documents", "text": "Collect the formal grant agreement, vesting schedule exhibit, and tax withholding election instructions for Adrian Copperwisp's Pocket Lantern Analytics restricted stock units (initial stated grant value $360,000, vesting over three years); he currently has only the offer letter and RSU summary.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2025-08-15", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "Adrian had the offer letter and summary of restricted stock units but did not yet have the formal grant agreement, vesting schedule exhibit, or tax withholding election instructions. {"title": "Set new 401(k) contribution election", "text": "Recommend Adrian Copperwisp's Pocket Lantern Analytics 401(k) contribution election, since his higher $285,000 salary and $40,000 signing bonus could make the default rate inconsistent with the household's retirement savings target for the remainder of the year.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2025-08-08", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "The agreed follow-up on Adrian’s Pocket Lantern Analytics 401(k) contribution election is due 2025-08-08."},
{"title": "Analyze Roth versus pre-tax deferral mix", "text": "Analyze whether Adrian Copperwisp's Pocket Lantern Analytics 401(k) deferrals should be pre-tax, Roth, or split, given the $40,000 signing bonus, expected equity income, Lena's wages, and the household's current tax bracket.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2025-08-12", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "Adrian also asked for an analysis of whether his new 401(k) deferrals should be pre-tax, Roth, or split, given the signing bonus, expected equity income, Lena’s wages, and the household’s current tax bracket. {"title": "Review former employer stock concentration in old plan", "text": "Review the concentration from approximately $52,000 of Buttonwood Balloon Robotics company stock units held in Adrian Copperwisp's former 401(k), a separate concentration issue from the household's taxable technology ETF position at Velvet Acorn Custody.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2025-08-18", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "The agreed follow-up on the former employer stock concentration review inside the old plan is due 2025-08-18."},
{"title": "Estimate signing bonus withholding adequacy", "text": "Review Adrian Copperwisp's paycheck and estimated taxes to determine whether supplemental withholding on the $40,000 Pocket Lantern Analytics signing bonus is too low when combined with Lena's wages and expected equity income, to avoid underpayment penalties.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2025-08-20", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "he asked for a paycheck and estimated-tax review. The agreed follow-up on the signing bonus withholding estimate is due 2025-08-20."},
{"title": "Coordinate CPA tax projections for transition year", "text": "Coordinate the transition-year tax projection with Priya Maplesprocket of Mossy Meteor CPAs before year-end planning decisions, covering two W-2s for Adrian, Lena's wages, the signing bonus, possible restricted stock income, and prior quarterly estimated payments.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2025-09-05", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "the tax projection needs to be coordinated with Priya Maplesprocket before year-end planning decisions are made.
